text: This report responds to City Council direction on the establishment of supports and guidelines for Toronto's Business Improvement Areas to create pollinator habitat. The report outlines the initiatives that the City will be undertaking in order to help Business Improvement Areas in Toronto adopt the guiding principles of the Pollinator Protection Strategy.
The Economic and Community Development Committee received the report (May 9, 2022) from the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture for information.
